reviews.title: Very cool LCD AIO with good but not great cooling
reviews.comment: I think the LCD is stunning. I use the analog clock option and it helps "class up" my pc. That said, the cooling isn't as good as the Noctua air cooler I replaced with this. I have a Ryzen 9 9950x3d and at idle it can get around 40 degrees but wants to sit much higher (60ish) with a minimal load. Its all fine and I got good value, but I also value aesthetics more than performance.
reviews.author: Solomon

reviews.title: Great AIO Cooler
reviews.comment: This Aio cooler is really good, got in my prebuilt Xidax Pc from 2016, no issues with it so far its keeping my Ryzen 9950x 16Core Cpu at 21-24 Celsius at idial at the highest ive seen with the front ventilation panel on my case closed while gaming was 41 Celsius, But with it open it goes down to 34 Celsius.
